A total of 16 teams contested the league, with [[ES Sétif]] as the defending champions for the second time consecutively. The league began on August 24, 2013.{{cite web|url=https://www.lequipe.fr/Football/FootballResultat45129.html|title=Championnat d'Algérie 2012-2013, 1ère journée|date=2013|language=fr|publisher=[[L'Équipe]]}} ==Team summaries== === Promotion and relegation === '''Teams promoted from [[2012–13 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2]]'''{{cite web|url=http://fr.starafrica.com/football/algerie-trois-promus-vraiment-promus.html|title=Algérie : Trois promus vraiment promus !|date=May 2, 2013|language=fr|author=Fayçal Chehat|publisher=StarAfrica|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140606205305/http://fr.starafrica.com/football/algerie-trois-promus-vraiment-promus.html|archive-date=June 6, 2014|url-status=dead|df=mdy-all}} * [[CRB Aïn Fakroun]] * [[RC Arbaâ]] * [[MO Béjaïa]] '''Teams relegated to [[2013-14 Algerian Ligue Professionnelle 2]]'''{{cite web|url=http://www.dzfoot.com/2013/05/12/ligue-1-28e-j-tlemcen-bel-abbes-batna-en-l2-duel-algerois-pour-la-seconde-place-11540.php|title=Tlemcen, Bel Abbés, Batna en L2|date=May 12, 2013|language=fr|publisher=DZFoot}} * [[CA Batna]] * [[USM Bel-Abbès]] * [[WA Tlemcen]] ===Stadiums and locations=== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
